changelog:
Major update: Skill rewritten to provide an Instagram data API alternative via fetcher.sh (read-only, pay-per-call), replacing prior posting scripts and Meta Graph API integration.

- All endpoints are now HTTP GET for profile, posts, reels, stories, hashtags, locations, audio, followers, and comments — no posting/upload support.
- Payment via USDC (x402) or Bearer API key; no login, session, or business verification required.
- Core focus: resolve by @handle, search users, pull content feeds, export followers, read comments, and track hashtags/locations.
- In-depth references added: endpoints list, usage scenarios, FAQs, and official-vs-alternative comparison.
- Removed posting shell scripts and all details on Imgur/media hosting and Meta setup.
- Skill is now documentation-driven and scenario-based, targeting data pipeline and social monitoring use cases.
summary: An Instagram API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no login and no session cookies. Use when the user wants to resolve an Instagram profile by @handle, search users by keyword, pull a profile's posts, reels, stories, tagged posts, followers, or followings, look up a single post by its shortcode, read a post's comments, fetch posts under a hashtag or reel-only hashtag feed, pull posts from a location, or pull posts using a specific audio/music track. Also covers Instagram follower export, hashtag and location monitoring, influencer discovery, competitor content tracking, and Instagram data pipelines without an official Graph API business verification or a headless browser.
